facts.value: In motion state 0, delegates to it_8026D62C with it_80294B58 and then returns false. The shared helper updates collision-derived position and, when supported, the floor index. If support is absent, it calls it_802762BC and invokes the supplied continuation, selecting state 1. With support present, it additionally calls Item_8026ADC0 when it_80277544(gobj) is nonzero and xDCD_flag.b3 is clear. The wrapper's false result does not rule out these delegated side effects or other shared lifetime processing.
